title: MLLPA
summary: A documented and reusable Python module for machine-learning-assisted analysis of lipid-membrane phases obtained from molecular-dynamics simulations.

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: MLLPA makes reusable the methods developed to study the phases and transitions of simulated lipid membranes.

sections.title: Personal contribution
paragraphs: Development of approximately 95% of the module’s code and creation of the entire website and documentation.
items: Development of machine-learning approaches using scikit-learn.
Later work on an unpublished 3D CNN using TensorFlow.

sections.title: Availability
paragraphs: The software, its website and documentation are publicly available.
